verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-2 approval remains supported. The repository-name guard correctly separates credential fallback eligibility from cross-repository deduplication, so same-repository routes with distinct tokens retain retry behavior without closing the live primary issue. The stateful regression test exercises that call-site configuration and asserts both retained open state and absence of close/comment mutations. The different-repository path rechecks the open marker before closing, comments only after a confirmed close, and leaves dedup best-effort without masking primary delivery. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
